name: Serbia
description: JMBG, PIB, and Serbian phone numbers.

rules.label: JMBG
rules.notes: Same 13-digit check as the previous built-in rule. Any valid JMBG is found, including numbers issued outside Serbia.

rules.label: PIB
rules.notes: Nine digits. The last digit is ISO 7064 mod 11,10. A nearby label is required. Turned on for region RS or when a profile enables it.

rules.label: Serbian phone
rules.notes: International +381, a mobile starting with 06, or a Belgrade 011 number.
